text: dsh-gateway-notify 是 DSH 的会话通知插件。它监听 agent 回合事件，并在长任务完成、失败或审批请求长时间未处理时推送消息到用户配置的 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Server酱、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 或通用 webhook。通知可包含项目目录名、耗时、模型、错误信息或等待审批的工具；默认不发送提示词和回复正文，开启 includeText 后才附带最终回复开头。适合需要远程了解 DSH 会话状态的用户，渠道需按需配置相应凭据。

dsh-gateway-notify sends alerts for DSH turn completion, failure, and unanswered approvals to a configured phone or chat channel. It supports ntfy, Bark, Feishu, Telegram, and webhooks. Messages omit reply text unless includeText is enabled. Configure the credentials required by the chosen channel.
想在 DSH 长任务结束或报错时收到手机推送。
让 DSH 在审批请求一直没人处理时提醒我。
Send me a chat or phone notification when a long DSH run finishes or fails.
dsh-gateway-notify 的功能「会话结束提醒」：长时间运行的 agent 回合完成或报错时，插件会推送状态、耗时及模型等信息；可配置推送到所选消息渠道。
dsh-gateway-notify 的功能「审批等待提醒」：审批请求超过配置的等待时间仍未决定时，插件会向已配置渠道推送提醒，并可显示正在等待的工具名称。
通知会通过 HTTPS POST 发往所选渠道；默认含项目目录名、耗时、模型或错误信息。开启 includeText 后还会发送最终回复开头，通用 webhook 会接收事件 JSON。
各渠道按需使用 token、key、chat id 或机器人 webhook；字符串可写成 env:NAME 从环境变量读取，适合避免把这些凭据直接放进 profile 配置。

dsh-gateway-notify README · dsh-gateway-notify：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that pushes to your phone or team chat when an agent turn ends after running a while, when a turn fails, or when the agent has been waiting on your approval.

中文：dsh 的长任务结束、失败或卡在等你审批时，推送到 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Server酱、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 或任意 webhook。默认不发送提示词和回复正文。

dsh-gateway-notify README · dsh-gateway-notify：Ported from [`@magpie-community/gateway-notify`](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/tree/main/packages/notify) (MIT, © magpie-community contributors). The channel code is theirs, nearly unchanged.

dsh-gateway-notify README · When it pushes：| dsh event | Push |
|---|---|
| `turn/end` with `completed` or `max-tokens`, turn ran ≥ `minMinutes` | ✅ done, with duration and model |
| `turn/end` with `error` | ❌ failed, with the error message (any duration, if `errors` is on) |
| `approval/asked` not decided within `approvalDelaySeconds` | ⏳ needs approval, with the tool name |
| `turn/end` with `aborted` | nothing: you pressed stop, so you're at the keyboard |
| `blocked`, `interrupted`, `forked` | nothing |
dsh-gateway-notify README · When it pushes：Subagent sessions (those with a parent session) stay quiet unless `subagents: true`. At most one push per session per `cooldownSeconds`.

dsh-gateway-notify README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-gateway-notify
```

Requires Node ≥ 24.9 (the same as dsh). Tested with dsh 0.2.1-rc.5.
dsh-gateway-notify README · Configure：```yaml

dsh-gateway-notify README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: gateway-notify
  config:
    minMinutes: 3
    channels:
      - type: ntfy
        topic: env:NTFY_TOPIC          # any string field may be env:NAME
        token: env:NTFY_TOKEN          # optional, for a protected topic
      - type: bark
        key: env:BARK_KEY
      - type: feishu
        webhook: env:FEISHU_WEBHOOK
        secret: env:FEISHU_SECRET
```

dsh-gateway-notify README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：Put tokens, keys and webhook URLs in environment variables and reference them as `env:NAME`; then nothing secret sits in the profile.

dsh-gateway-notify README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `channels` | `[]` | where to push (below) |
| `minMinutes` | `3` | only push for turns at least this long |
| `cooldownSeconds` | `30` | at most one push per session in this window |
| `errors` | `true` | push failed turns, however short |
| `approvals` | `true` | push approvals left waiting |
| `approvalDelaySeconds` | `60` | how long an approval waits before the push |
| `subagents` | `false` | also push for subagent sessions |
| `includeText` | `false` | add the start of the final reply |
| `maxTextLength` | `200` | how much of it |
| `lang` | `en` | `en` or `zh` |

dsh-gateway-notify README · Channels：| `type` | Needs | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `ntfy` | `topic` | `server` (default ntfy.sh), `token`, `priority`, `tags` |
| `bark` | `key` | `server` (default api.day.app), `group`, `sound` |
| `gotify` | `server`, `token` | `priority` |
| `serverchan` | `key` (SCT… or sctp…) | |
| `feishu` | `webhook` | `secret` |
| `dingtalk` | `webhook` | `secret` |
| `wecom` | `webhook` | |
| `telegram` | `token`, `chatId` | `server` |
| `webhook` | `url` | `headers`; body is `{ title, body, event }` |
dsh-gateway-notify README · Channels：Add `off: true` to keep a channel in config without sending to it.

dsh-gateway-notify README · Privacy：By default a push carries only the project folder name, the duration, the model, and for failures the error message. Prompts and replies are not sent unless you turn on `includeText`. Each channel is one HTTPS POST to the service you configured; nothing goes anywhere else.
